_comment: Shared by test/aibom-rust-parity.test.mjs (JS, cli/local-model-names.mjs) and src-tauri/src/local_model_names.rs (Rust cargo test). Each expectation is the JS reference's output; both sides must reproduce it. Paths ending in '/' are directories, a '!' segment is an entry whose read fails, {gen,count} expands {i}. HTTP cases are served as raw bytes from 127.0.0.1.

trees.name: tricky layouts, hidden entries, read errors and names
deadline during the walk (5 ms per clock read, 40 ms)
deadline exactly at the end of the walk
a clock read equal to the deadline still reads (the JS check is now() > deadline)
a directory of exactly maxPerDir entries is flagged truncated
maxEntries reached on the end-of-directory read
maxEntries hit exactly by an end-of-directory read stops later runtimes without flagging truncated
small maxEntries over the full tree

http.name: redirect off the device is not followed
200 gzip-labelled plain JSON (no decoding on either side)
chunked body one byte over httpMaxBytes
close-delimited body one byte over httpMaxBytes
Content-Length longer than the body, then close
chunked cut off before the last chunk
Transfer-Encoding without chunked is delimited by close
chunk size 2^64-1 as the first chunk (overflow)
